en.hero:
Seeing the world from
a runner's perspective.
en.intro: Not a pro athlete. Not a travel blogger. Just a guy who takes his running shoes everywhere, maps out runs and rates the local running conditions.
en.aboutExcerpt: I’m from Estonia, I work in digital marketing, and I travel with my running shoes.
en.aboutBody:
## Starting point

Growing up in Estonia, I started cross-country skiing as a child. Snowboarding came later, along with a few injuries. By the time I was eighteen, I was spending more time partying, going to the gym only occasionally and sometimes attempting a 2 to 3 km run.

Around 2018, I remember weighing a little over 100 kg (I should point out that I’m no saint now, either: I still enjoy the occasional night out with friends, and there’s room for enjoying life alongside running). My initial goal was to lose 20 to 25 kg so I could compete in karting in the Rotax DD2 class. Running became the way I worked towards it, alongside improving my eating habits. I reached my goal, and things went pretty well in both racing and running.

![A kart race and me beside a racing kart in the paddock](/assets/uploads/my-story/karting.jpg "I’m the driver in the black helmet and red kart.")

As I got fitter, I began to feel faster and started running half marathons and full marathons. Eventually, I decided to make running my main hobby. I could do it almost anywhere, which made it much easier to fit into my life, and it was a lot cheaper than karting. :)

But then I started having stomach problems during those longer races.

## Focus shift

Over the years, that became a frustrating part of racing marathons and half marathons. I have now attempted nine marathons and plenty of half marathons, but despite countless doctor visits, I still have not found a clear explanation for what keeps happening. After so long, I sometimes wonder whether part of it is in my head by now. I honestly do not know.

At the same time, shorter distances, especially 10 km, have gone really well. I decided to put marathon goals aside for a while, which left me wondering what the next goal could be.

Then I realised the answer had been right in front of me. I enjoy writing, and I already had routes, photos and memories from the places I have visited over the years with my running shoes. Bringing those experiences together felt like a good new direction. That is how Runograph came about.

## Rocca Sörk: sharing the running

Sharing running with other people was already part of my life before Runograph. In July 2025, I started Rocca Sörk together with Berit, Birgit and Kristjan. It has since grown into a big running community by Estonian standards, far beyond the small group we began with.

Our regular club run is every Tuesday at 18:30. During the summer season, we also get together for bike rides, and from time to time we organise larger events. It is another part of what I enjoy about running: the people it brings together.

![Rocca Sörk runners warming up and running together, with Markus, Berit, Birgit and Kristjan in the middle photograph](/assets/uploads/my-story/rocca-sork-community.jpg "Rocca Sörk: club runs and events, with me, Berit, Birgit and Kristjan in the middle photo.")

You can find our latest runs, rides and events on [Rocca Sörk’s Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/roccasork/).

## What you will find here

Here on Runograph, I’m collecting the useful parts of my own runs: the routes I actually ran, where I could settle into a rhythm, how safe it felt, what the surface was like and whether I would go back. The scores are my personal impressions of the running, and the maps make it easier to see which parts might suit your own trip.

I will keep adding places as I revisit old memories and take my shoes somewhere new.

et.intro: Ei ole profisportlane ega täiskohaga reisiblogija. Lihtsalt üks tüüp, kes võtab jooksutossud igale poole kaasa, kaardistab jooksupaiku ja hindab kohalikke jooksutingimusi.
et.aboutTitle:
Kõik algas kardisõidust.
Sellest sai eluviis.
et.aboutExcerpt: Murdmaasuusad, lumelaud, mõned vigastused ja ootamatu põhjus jooksma hakata. Nii see teekond algas.
et.aboutBody:
## Kõigepealt tuli lumi

Kasvasin üles Eestis, kus lumine talv tegi murdmaasuusatamisest loomuliku valiku. Hiljem hakkasin lumelauaga sõitma. See tundus lahedam, aga tõi kaasa ka vigastusi.

## Teistsugune stardijoon

Kaheksateistkümneselt pidutsesin palju ja jõusaali jõudsin pigem harva. Aastateks 2018-2019 oli kaal kerkinud umbes 100 kilogrammini. Kardisõidu ja motospordi nimel tahtsin alla võtta 20-25 kg. Sellest sai minu põhjus jooksma hakata.

## Üheksa maratonikatset. Seejärel uus fookus.

Minu jooksuteekonda kuulub üheksa maratonikatset. Hiljem nihkus fookus 10 km distantsile.

## Jooksmine koos teistega

Asutasin Rocca Sörgi. Jooksmisest oli saanud midagi, mida tahtsin teistega jagada.

## Kaugtöö ja jooksutossud

Töötan digiturunduses ja teen kaugtööd. Reisides käin alati jooksmas. See päevik toob kokku minu loo, uued paigad ja lihtsa harjumuse jooksutossud jalga panna.

Sihtkohtade lehed koondavad paigad, kus olen jooksnud. Täiendan neid enda tähelepanekute, fotode ja jooksukogemustega.
